info.title: Marketplace API
info.description: Multi-vendor marketplace: catalogue, cart, checkout, orders, store space rental, rider dispatch and live delivery tracking. Authenticate with a Supabase access token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Money is integer cents with a currency code. Errors look like `{"error": {"code": "...", "message": "..."}}`.

post.description:
Turns the cart (or the `items` sent) into an order.

Only variant ids and quantities are read from the client. Prices, volume
tiers, coupons, shipping and tax are all worked out by place_order() in
the database while the stock rows are locked.

Switch plan. The new rent applies from the next billing date; the
commission rate applies to orders placed from now on.

delete.description:
Products that have been ordered are archived, not deleted, so order
history keeps its links.

ledgers: a debit on a store is income for the platform.
